title: Scheduled deploys
cronTip: Standard 5-field cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, each either a number, a range (1-5), a step (*/15), or * for any value. "0 3 * * *" means every day at 03:00. The schedule is checked at least once a minute, so nothing finer than minute granularity is meaningful.
intro: Redeploys the latest commit on a branch, on a cron schedule or once at a set time. A deploy due during an active deploy freeze window is skipped, not forced, and recorded below.
nextRunUnsaved: save a schedule to see its next run
nextRunDone: Next run: none, the one-time deploy already ran
cronRequired: Cron and branch are both required.
runAtInvalid: Pick a valid date and time.
noRuns: No scheduled deploys have run yet.

statusTip.skipped_freeze: Skipped: deploys were frozen at that time
statusTip.skipped_missed: Skipped: the server was down past the catch-up window
